title: kit.broker-evidence.v1
description: One evidence record of the broker: every authenticated allow and deny, hash-chained (hash = sha256 of the canonical JSON of the record without `hash`; prev = the previous record's hash, or 64 zeros for the first). Never carries a token or key.

request.description: sha256 of the canonical signed request.

base.description: The base branch: the reviewed one, or, for merged_wrong_base, the one GitHub actually merged into.

merged.description: The merge commit: from GitHub's merge reply, or from the merged pull request read back (reasons merged, merged_wrong_base, merged_unverified). Never an open pull request's test-merge commit.

reviewedBase.description: For merged_wrong_base: the base the review was signed for.
